articles.summary: Organization owners can now configure usage caps to limit the total number of build minutes their team can use in a given month.
articles.title: Now available: Usage caps

articles.summary: We're excited to announce that Depot has joined the Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) as a silver member to help more folks learn about and use cloud native technologies like Depot.
articles.title: Depot is now a member of the CNCF

articles.summary: We're excited to announce that with our new configure-docker command, you can now use Depot to build the images in your Docker Compose file automatically without changing a single line of code.
articles.title: Now available: Use Docker Compose with Depot
